import sys, json, hashlib
from pathlib import Path
sys.path.insert(0, '/tealab-data/rjin02/RVCBench/checkpoints/fish-speech-s2-native')
import torch
from fish_speech.models.dac.inference import load_model
from fish_speech.inference_engine.reference_loader import ReferenceLoader
from fish_speech.inference_engine.vq_manager import VQManager
from fish_speech.utils import set_seed
from torch.nn.attention import sdpa_kernel, SDPBackend
set_seed(42)
torch.set_num_threads(8)
codec=load_model('modded_dac_vq','/tealab-data/rjin02/AudioWatermarkBench/checkpoints/s2-pro/codec.pth','cuda:0')
class Engine(ReferenceLoader, VQManager):
    def __init__(self):
        ReferenceLoader.__init__(self)
        self.decoder_model=codec
engine=Engine()
audio=Path('/tealab-data/rjin02/RVCBench/data/Libritts/audios/121/121_127105_000043_000007.wav').read_bytes()
rows=[]
def record(label,codes):
    value=codes.detach().cpu().contiguous()
    rows.append({'label':label,'shape':list(value.shape),'sha256':hashlib.sha256(value.numpy().tobytes()).hexdigest(),
                 'sdpa':{'flash':torch.backends.cuda.flash_sdp_enabled(),'math':torch.backends.cuda.math_sdp_enabled(),'efficient':torch.backends.cuda.mem_efficient_sdp_enabled(),'cudnn':torch.backends.cuda.cudnn_sdp_enabled()}})
    print(json.dumps(rows[-1]),flush=True)
    return codes
with torch.inference_mode():
    first=record('first_encode',engine.encode_reference(audio,True))
    record('second_encode',engine.encode_reference(audio,True))
    with torch.autocast('cuda',torch.bfloat16):
        codec.from_indices(first[None])
    record('encode_after_decode',engine.encode_reference(audio,True))
    with sdpa_kernel(SDPBackend.MATH):
        record('math_only_encode',engine.encode_reference(audio,True))
    with sdpa_kernel(SDPBackend.FLASH_ATTENTION):
        record('flash_only_encode',engine.encode_reference(audio,True))
    record('restored_encode',engine.encode_reference(audio,True))
Path('/tealab-data/rjin02/RVCBench/reproduction/comparisons/fish_s2_codec_repeat_probe.json').write_text(json.dumps({'status':'complete','audio_sha256':hashlib.sha256(audio).hexdigest(),'observations':rows},indent=2)+'\n')
